event_es: El FOMC anunció un intervalo objetivo del 1,50–1,75 % para el tipo de los fondos federales.
event_en: The FOMC announced a federal funds target range of 1.50–1.75%.
secondary_date_note: Public statement at 14:00 EDT. The linked implementation note directs the New York Fed's desk to use the new range from June 16.

event_es: El BCE empezó a aplicar un tipo del 0 % en la facilidad de depósito tras la subida acordada en julio.
event_en: The ECB's deposit facility rate of 0% took effect under its July rate decision.
secondary_date_note: On July 21 the ECB published its decision and specified July 27 as the effective date.

event_es: El Banco de Canadá anunció que subía al 1 % el objetivo para el tipo de financiación a un día.
event_en: The Bank of Canada announced a rise to 1% in its overnight rate target.
secondary_date_note: April 25 in the same release concerns the start of quantitative tightening, a separate decision.

event_es: El Banco de Inglaterra publicó la decisión del comité de subir el Bank Rate al 0,25 %.
event_en: The Bank of England published the committee's decision to raise Bank Rate to 0.25%.
secondary_date_note: The meeting ended December 15. The public summary is dated December 16.

event_es: El Banco de la Reserva de Australia anunció una subida de 25 puntos básicos del objetivo para el tipo de interés a un día, hasta el 0,35 %.
event_en: The Reserve Bank of Australia announced a 25-basis-point increase in its cash rate target, to 0.35%.
secondary_date_note: This is the Board decision in the dated release. The RBA historical cash-rate series records the new rate from May 4.

event_es: El Banco Nacional Suizo suprimió el tipo de cambio mínimo de 1,20 francos suizos por euro.
event_en: The Swiss National Bank discontinued its floor of 1.20 Swiss francs per euro.
secondary_date_note: The target is withdrawal of the exchange-rate floor. The press release also announces a distinct change in interest on sight deposits.

event_es: Adobe y Figma anunciaron que habían acordado poner fin al acuerdo de fusión.
event_en: Adobe and Figma announced their mutual termination of the merger agreement.
secondary_date_note: The proposed acquisition was announced September 15, 2022. The December release documents the parties' termination agreement.

event_es: SoftBank Group comunicó en Japón la resolución del acuerdo de venta de Arm a NVIDIA.
event_en: SoftBank Group publicly reported in Japan that its agreement to sell Arm to NVIDIA had been terminated.
secondary_date_note: Japanese issuer's date. The original sale agreement was dated September 13, 2020, US time. Fix the reporting calendar before using an intraday cutoff.

event_es: SAP anunció la venta completada de su participación en Qualtrics al grupo comprador encabezado por Silver Lake.
event_en: SAP announced completion of the sale of its Qualtrics stake to the Silver Lake-led buyer group.
secondary_date_note: The dated release confirms completion. The target is the public announcement and does not require an independently timed transfer of shares.

event_es: Los billetes y monedas en euros entraron en circulación en Croacia al incorporarse el país a la zona del euro.
event_en: Euro notes and coins entered circulation in Croatia as it joined the euro area.
secondary_date_note: The EU Council had adopted the final legal acts on July 12, 2022. This event is the actual switch to the euro.

event_es: La Reserva Federal anunció que FedNow ya estaba operativo para las entidades participantes.
event_en: The Federal Reserve announced that FedNow was live for participating institutions.
secondary_date_note: This is the July 20 service announcement. It is not a claim about an individual customer's first payment.

event_es: Entró en vigor el tratado comercial entre México, Estados Unidos y Canadá (T-MEC).
event_en: The United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement (USMCA) entered into force.
secondary_date_note: The target is entry into force. Advance government notices of a scheduled start are a distinct publication event.

event_es: Entró en vigor la Ley 7/2023 de protección de los derechos y el bienestar de los animales.
event_en: Spanish Law 7/2023 on animal rights and welfare entered into force.
secondary_date_note: The law is dated 28 March 2023 and appeared in the BOE on 29 March. Its ninth final provision set a six-month interval.

event_es: El Boletín Oficial del Estado publicó la Ley 13/2022, General de Comunicación Audiovisual.
event_en: The Spanish official gazette published Law 13/2022 on audiovisual communication.
secondary_date_note: The law itself is dated 7 July 2022. The target is publication in issue 163.

event_es: Entró en vigor el Reglamento (UE) 2024/1689 de inteligencia artificial.
event_en: EU Regulation 2024/1689 on artificial intelligence entered into force.
secondary_date_note: The original act is dated 13 June 2024 and appeared in the Official Journal on 12 July. Article 113 distinguishes entry into force from staggered application: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1689/oj/eng

event_es: El Tribunal Constitucional dictó la sentencia 44/2023 sobre el recurso contra la Ley Orgánica 2/2010 de salud sexual y reproductiva.
event_en: The Spanish Constitutional Court delivered judgment 44/2023 on the challenge to Organic Law 2/2010 on sexual and reproductive health.
secondary_date_note: The judgment appeared in issue 139 of the official gazette on 12 June 2023.

event_es: El Consejo Constitucional francés dictó la decisión 2023-849 DC sobre la ley rectificativa de financiación de la seguridad social para 2023.
event_en: The French Constitutional Council issued decision 2023-849 DC on the 2023 amending social security financing law.
secondary_date_note: The decision appeared in the Journal officiel on 15 April 2023.

event_es: El Tribunal Constitucional Federal alemán dictó el auto sobre la Ley Federal de Protección del Clima en el asunto 1 BvR 2656/18 y acumulados.
event_en: The German Federal Constitutional Court issued its order on the Federal Climate Change Act in case 1 BvR 2656/18 and joined cases.
secondary_date_note: The court announced publication in press release 31/2021 on 29 April 2021: https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/DE/2021/bvg21-031.html

event_es: El Tribunal Supremo del Reino Unido dictó la sentencia [2019] UKSC 41 en los asuntos Miller y Cherry sobre la suspensión del Parlamento.
event_en: The UK Supreme Court delivered judgment [2019] UKSC 41 in Miller and Cherry on the prorogation of Parliament.
secondary_date_note: The appeals were heard on 17–19 September 2019.

event_es: El Tribunal Supremo de Estados Unidos resolvió el asunto Obergefell v. Hodges.
event_en: The US Supreme Court decided Obergefell v. Hodges.
secondary_date_note: The case was argued on 28 April 2015. See 576 U.S. 644, first page of the syllabus, in the official bound-volume preliminary print.

event_es: México celebró la jornada electoral extraordinaria para elegir diversos cargos del Poder Judicial de la Federación.
event_en: Mexico held extraordinary polling for offices in the federal judiciary.
secondary_date_note: The INE council transcript published on 10 June records the earlier polling date.

event_es: El Tribunal Calificador de Elecciones de Chile proclamó la victoria de la opción En Contra en el plebiscito sobre la propuesta de nueva Constitución.
event_en: The Chilean electoral tribunal proclaimed the victory of the option opposing the proposed new constitution in the constitutional plebiscite.
secondary_date_note: The single-page signed proclamation dates the vote to 17 December 2023 and the proclamation to 2 January 2024. See the scanned page image.

event_es: La Comisión Electoral Australiana devolvió al gobernador general el documento oficial con el resultado del referéndum federal de 2023.
event_en: The Australian Electoral Commission returned the writ for the 2023 federal referendum to the Governor-General.
secondary_date_note: Polling took place on 14 October 2023. The timetable records both stages: https://www.aec.gov.au/Elections/referendums/2023-timetable.htm

event_es: La responsable nacional del escrutinio declaró en Manchester el resultado del referéndum británico sobre la pertenencia a la UE.
event_en: The Chief Counting Officer declared the result of the UK referendum on EU membership in Manchester.
secondary_date_note: Voting took place on 23 June. Paragraph 4.68 records certification at 07:08 and declaration at 07:20 the following morning, local time.

event_es: La Unión Europea de Radiodifusión anunció la cancelación de Eurovisión 2020 en Róterdam.
event_en: The European Broadcasting Union announced the cancellation of the 2020 Eurovision Song Contest in Rotterdam.
secondary_date_note: The contest had been planned for May 2020. The statement treats possible hosting in 2021 as a separate discussion.

event_es: La UEFA anunció que aplazaba doce meses la Eurocopa de 2020.
event_en: UEFA announced a twelve-month postponement of its 2020 European football championship.
secondary_date_note: The published schedule had run from 12 June to 12 July 2020. Dates in June and July 2021 were proposals on the announcement date.

event_es: La Fórmula 1 anunció que el Gran Premio de Emilia-Romaña de 2023 en Imola quedaba cancelado para ese fin de semana.
event_en: Formula 1 announced that the 2023 Emilia Romagna Grand Prix weekend at Imola was called off.
secondary_date_note: The notice was issued at 11:16 UTC on 17 May about the upcoming weekend. It does not report that a race took place.

event_es: World Rugby y el comité organizador anunciaron la cancelación del partido de la fase de grupos entre Inglaterra y Francia por el tifón Hagibis.
event_en: World Rugby and the organisers announced the cancellation of the England–France pool match because of Typhoon Hagibis.
secondary_date_note: The match had been scheduled for 12 October 2019. The same notice also cancelled New Zealand–Italy, which is not counted as a second event here.

event_es: El tramo central de la Elizabeth line entre Paddington y Abbey Wood se abrió a los viajeros.
event_en: The central section of the Elizabeth line opened to passengers between Paddington and Abbey Wood.
secondary_date_note: Transport for London reported first-day passenger counts in its board paper dated 8 June 2022, section 3.1.

event_es: La Torre Eiffel abrió al público durante la Exposición Universal de París.
event_en: The Eiffel Tower opened to the public during the Paris Exposition Universelle.
secondary_date_note: The operator describes the historical public opening retrospectively in its 130th-anniversary series.

event_es: La línea de alta velocidad Madrid–Sevilla entró en servicio comercial.
event_en: Commercial service began on the Madrid–Seville high-speed railway.
secondary_date_note: Adif records a separate inauguration on 14 April 1992. The target is the first day of commercial service.

event_es: La Conferencia de las Naciones Unidas sobre los Océanos de 2022 se abrió en Lisboa en su primera sesión plenaria.
event_en: The 2022 United Nations Ocean Conference opened in Lisbon at its first plenary meeting.
secondary_date_note: The official conference report identifies the opening in paragraph 5. The conference ran until 1 July 2022.

event_es: La Fundación César Manrique inauguró oficialmente su sede en Taro de Tahíche, Lanzarote.
event_en: The César Manrique Foundation formally inaugurated its headquarters in Taro de Tahíche, Lanzarote.
secondary_date_note: The foundation distinguishes its formal inauguration from opening to the public on 1 April 1992, five days later.

event_es: El puente Golden Gate se abrió al tráfico de vehículos.
event_en: The Golden Gate Bridge opened to motor vehicles.
secondary_date_note: The bridge district records Pedestrian Day on 27 May 1937, the day before motor vehicles were admitted.
